title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day — Episode5 An Unexpected Visitor

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Event Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Line: A few minutes later
Shoebill Habitat

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Pardon me!
I'm here to clean your habitat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Wince*
(His gaze feels so cold... But I can't give up!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Anyway, I'm used to cleaning on the animal caretaking committee. I'm gonna surprise Schubert by making this place spotless!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Starting with his pool.
He drinks from it, so I need to make it really clean!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... I have to drain it first, by pulling this plug...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, and I can use this water to make everything nice and clean! Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Or two Schuberts with one stone!
Just kidding!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, he's still staring at me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Actually, I think he's been slowly walking towards me...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm sure I'm just imagining things!
Anyway, I need to work on making this place spotless.
se_event_keeper_2023_006

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?!?!
He's so close! Does this mean we're friends now?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Y-Y-Yes, how can I help you?!
Why are you poking me with your beak?!?!
<Oh, this bird's so big.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
That sounded like...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<And it has a lovely beak.
It's so cute how it's poking you, Minori. I'm really jealous♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Luka?!
What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <After you told us you'd be going to a zoo today, I was curious what animals they have.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<So...
I decided to drop in♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Oh, okay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Still, you really startled me!
Thank goodness Shiho and Mr. Nakazawa aren't here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I made sure to wait until they were both gone, so don't worry♪ I'll hide when they return.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Also...
This shoebill's name is Schubert, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <He looks so big and powerful. I feel like he could gobble me up whole.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He probably does look really big right now because of how little you are on my phone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm sure you heard earlier, but he's really docile! He did start poking me with his beak just now for some reason... But he was as still as a statue when I was feeding him!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes, you're right.
Even when I popped out, he didn't seem bothered at all.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <He may have what it takes to become an idol.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Even the most experienced idols feel a little nervous when they take the stage, no?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <But nothing seems to faze Schubert. His poise is really remarkable.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...!
I could learn a lot from him...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. At the same time, he'll need to learn how to smile a little more before he can become one.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Is it just me or does it seem like he wants to say something to us?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, where are my manners?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <How inconsiderate of me. I completely forgot to introduce myself before evaluating you like that.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <My name is Megurine Luka. Pleased to meet you, Schubert.>
se_event_keeper_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
D-Did you see that...?
I think Schubert just bowed to you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes...
It certainly looked like a bow.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It just looked like one...right?
Although, he—
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Ah, Ms. Hanasato, it seems that you and Schubert have worked things out!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-Huh...? We have...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Shoebills bow as a display of affection! So if someone he considers a friend bows, he'll return the gesture.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really...?!
I didn't know shoebills did that...!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Hehe. Fascinating, aren't they?
There are actually some other things they do to show their affection.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: I'll bet he was trying to thank you for cleaning his habitat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
H-Hehe...
But I'm not sure that bow was meant for me...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: No?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, uhh... I think it just happened to look like a bow...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I mean, he didn't eat any of the fish I offered him!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Yes, I gave that some thought...
Shoebills are very careful and deliberate by nature.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Which makes me believe that he was mulling over whether or not he could or would eat your fish, whether he was allowed to eat it yet and so on.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Yes. When you waved that fish in front of him, I'm guessing he was thinking about how he was actually going to eat it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Yeah... Come to think of it, I think Shiho kept her hand completely still when she offered him that fish.)

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: In any case, he probably feels grateful that you cleaned his habitat for him.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Try bowing to him now. I'm sure he'll bow back when you do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: He'll bow back...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I sure hope so...
But I still think that other bow was meant for Luka...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Still!
If there's a chance, even a tiny one, I should give it a try!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Would you like for us to be friends?!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Hehe. That wasn't quite a bow, but I'm sure he understands.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh... I guess I can't inspire Schubert...)
se_event_keeper_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Gasp*
Grassland Area

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori's taking pretty long...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(To be fair, Schubert's habitat is a lot bigger...
I kinda feel bad about making her clean it.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(And he didn't seem too fond of her.
What if he pecked her with that big beak and—)
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiiihooo!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What happened?
You seem really happy...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe. Schubert and I are super duper good friends now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, more than friends...
We're totally a crew now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A crew...? Not a word you hear much lately...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But hey, I'm happy you're both friends now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
That was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Anyway, Shiho, how'd things go on your end? Are you all done cleaning?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah.
It was pretty easy since they were so friendly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And...they were really cute.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's great to hear!
se_walk_women_002_2

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Thank you two very much for all your hard work! Both habitats look completely spotless now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Mr. Nakazawa!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you for teaching us everything.
I think we both learned quite a lot.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Actually, I was very impressed by how the animals took to you two so quickly. I think you both have what it takes to become zookeepers.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Anyway, this concludes the part where you work with the animals. Please come again to help if you ever get the chance!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Alright, let's take our break here.
After that, you'll need to head over to the room where you were given the rundown of today's program.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Oh, the second half mostly involves seeing what goes on behind the scenes in the back offices, so you can change back into your normal clothes.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mr. Nakazawa, thank you again!
